remarks: Nestled in the heart of vibrant South Norwalk, 9 Quintard Ave is a fantastic 2-family home that combines convenience, charm, and versatility. Perfectly situated near the city's bustling nightlife, major highways, public transportation, and the train station, this property offers an unbeatable location for both commuters and those who love having amenities at their fingertips.  The home features two spacious units, each thoughtfully designed for comfortable living. Unit 1 welcomes you with a classic wraparound front porch-ideal for sipping your morning coffee or relaxing after a long day. Unit 2 boasts 2 level living and its own private back deck, perfect for entertaining or enjoying some quiet outdoor time. Both units include in-home washers and dryers for added convenience. With a flat, easy-to-maintain backyard and ample driveway parking, there's plenty of space for outdoor fun and hassle-free living. Whether you're looking for an investment opportunity or a great place to live with rental income potential, this property delivers flexibility and value in one of Norwalk's most desirable locations. Don't miss your chance to own this gem-schedule a showing today!
